generate_enum_traits_header: run the code generator to produce a C++ enum_traits header from introspected mujoco enums
build_enum_trait_structs: build C++ struct definitions mapping each mujoco enum to its name and value pairs
create_enum_trait_tuple: create a constexpr tuple of all enum names for runtime enum iteration in C++
run_generate_enum_traits: run generate_enum_traits.py to print a complete enum_traits.h file to stdout
review_generate_enum_traits: review the generate_enum_traits.py script that transforms python enum declarations into C++ traits
